title: tectaria plantaginea var. macrocarpa
intro: Tectaria plantaginea var. macrocarpa, commonly known as the 'giant tectaria fern', is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of T. plantaginea var. macrocarpa include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are likely to be polyphenolic compounds and flavonoids, which are commonly found in ferns and have been reported to exhibit various pharmacological activities.
